author: Caroline Gaspich
title: ESPYs viewers slam in memoriam segment after presentation shake-up - NewsBreak
text: The In Memoriam segment during the 2025 ESPY Awards didn't sit right with some who were tuning in at home, and many listed why on X , formerly Twitter . Like each show, the annual awards ceremony honors the famous sports figures who have died over the course of the year. At the most recent ESPYs , while photos of the late athletes were shared across a screen, the notables' names weren't labeled on the pictures, as some viewers pointed out. "Why did you leave off the names?? Did you think we’d know all these in memoriam pictures? #ESPYS2025," one asked on X. One commented, "#ESPYS2025 Terrible job with the Memoriam! Hard to see the pictures, no names for the individuals and it was very rushed! Disappointing!!!" READ MORE: Controversial song that landed My Chemical Romance guitarist on FBI watchlist READ MORE: 'World's richest actor' is a billionaire but hasn't had a movie role in six years A second added, "Not a good In Memoriam. Why did they just put up random groups of people? #ESPYS2025," and a third shared, "Why would they do an in memoriam on the #ESPYS2025 without listing the names under the pictures?" Someone else quipped, "ESPYs “in memorial” segment was awful. Tiny pictures, no names, and making it all about the musical performer and not those being recognized. So disrespectful." While another ranted: "OMG this in memorium segment was awful... #ESPYS just showing the photographs of the sports figures without their names is disrespectful... not everyone knows the athletes by their pictures alone. Showing them in groups instead of individually is also disrespectful... plus.. hardcore RAP music as a background is improper....@espn you failed bigtime on this... not to mention your host is awful. worst ESPY's in Years!!!" Among those who disapproved of the segment, there were some who viewed it more positively. "Good to see a smiling #dwaynelukas included in #ESPYS2025 in memoriam segment #horseracing— Beth Harris," one wrote. The ESPYS , or Excellence in Sports Performance Yearly Awards, kicked off Wednesday, July 16, at The Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles , California. During the annual awards, athletes and celebrities gathered from all around to recognize outstanding achievements in sports within the past year. This year's event was hosted by beloved comedian Shane Gillis and featured a number of talented guest live performers. Some artists slated to take the stage include Busta Rhymes , Clipse, Tobe Nwigwe, and GELO. Grammy-nominated rapper Tobe Nwigwe will also be making an appearance at the ceremony as he leads the In Memoriam segment.
